data.description: External review Finding 6 follow-up. tests/lib/run-script-tests.sh discovers only test-*.sh (hyphen); underscore-named test_*.sh files (tests/scripts/test_write_cycle_ledger_v110.sh, tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd5_bundle.sh, tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh) are never run by the bash suite. The TMPDIR-isolation lint glob was broadened to cover them (PR for Finding 6), but DISCOVERY was not. Evidence of bit-rot: tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh has a PRE-EXISTING failing assertion ('strict + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset') confirmed failing on unmodified HEAD — it has been silently un-run. Scope: (1) decide whether each test_*.sh should run (rename to test-*.sh) or be retired; (2) fix or delete the failing bridge-imports test; (3) align run-script-tests.sh discovery with the lint glob. NOTE: bridge-imports test touches reconciler logic — coordinate with the CI/PR session.
data.title: Reconcile test-/test_ naming split so underscore tests are discovered (Finding 6 part 4)
